reels.name: 01_Can_You_Stop_The_Train_In_GTA6
reels.title: CAN YOU STOP THE GTA 6 TRAIN?!
reels.hook: CAN YOU FINALLY STOP THE TRAIN?!
reels.reason: Actual GTA 6 gameplay showing a player driving a car onto the tracks to stop the passenger train, proving it's no longer invincible.
reels.post_caption:
CAN YOU FINALLY STOP THE GTA 6 TRAIN?! In GTA 5 the train was 100% invincible, but in GTA 6 you can actually stop it by driving a car directly in front of the engine! Share this with a friend who thought it was impossible!
